title: AI Hacks to Crush Your Job Search and Land Interviews
description:
I’ll show you how to use AI to slash your resume-writing time, skip the endless tailoring headache, and create application materials that scream “hire me!” (without sounding like a robot wrote them). #ai #aiforjobs #aihacksforjobsearch #aiprompts #aipromptsforjobs #aitipsandtricks #jobsearch #careerstrategist

You’ll learn all my favorite hacks and prompts to make AI your job search sidekick — saving hours while still sounding 100% like you.

Because recruiters can spot AI-generated fluff a mile away… and I’ll help you make sure yours passes the human test and lands that interview.

For tips and tricks to write a resume and cover letter that gets interviews, fast, check out my resume and cover letter writing eGuide:

https://katekirchner.thinkific.com/products/digital_downloads/resume-and-cover-letter-writing-guide

For a deeper dive on everything resume and cover letter, that provides step-by-step on- demand instruction, check out my resume writing and cover letter course:
